issues.quote: If median wait does not fall, service rollout and text expansion stop
issues.concern: This is the only stop rule for a feature that is live at every sales rooftop on day one, but 'does not fall' has no size. At 1-2 rooftops with 20 episodes a week, the median will move on noise alone, so the check could pass on any drop. 'Text expansion' is also undefined, because R6 turns texts on automatically when a read or attestation qualifies. Nobody would know what to actually stop.
issues.because: PRD section 3 Goals 'Target: set after baseline'; section 10 '20 episodes a week' [ASSUMPTION]; R6
issues.ask: Tie the check to the Goals target set at the end of Phase 0 (for example, 'falls by at least the target set after Phase 0, before day one'). Define the text stop as 'no new rooftop attestations are accepted; read-qualified rooftops stay mark-only until the PM review'. If the PM wants to own the size, say so in Open question 4.
